description: WRITES. Records ONE gap report when these tools genuinely cannot answer something. Compose the existing tools first, file at most once per gap, and never put secrets or personal data in it. Not a retry mechanism.

category.description: What kind of gap this is. missing_dataset = a dataset this server doesn't carry at all; missing_field = a field absent from a payload it does carry; missing_filter = a filter or parameter an existing tool won't take; wrong_data = a value that looks wrong against a source you can cite; other = anything else.

context.description: Optional: which tool you attempted and the argument that fell short, e.g. 'get_events_calendar, no sector filter'. Max 200 characters, same refusal rule.

request.description: What is missing and what you were trying to answer, in one or two sentences. Max 400 characters — a longer string is REFUSED, not truncated. No secrets and no personal data.

name: submit_feedback
